newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil south rail concession fetches 217 mln reais.
newsitem.headline: Brazil south rail concession fetches 217 mln reais.

text.p: A consortium led by investment bank Banco Garantia on Friday acquired a 30-year concession to run the southern branch of Brazil's federal railway network, the Rio de Janeiro bourse said.
At an auction on the bolsa, the group bought the concession for 216.6 million reais, 37.08 percent above the base price of 158 million reais.
Only two bidders participated in the auction, which lasted over 40 minutes. The other group was led by private bank Banco Bozano, Simonsen.
The 4,100-mile (6,600-km) southern branch runs through some of Brazil's most prosperous territory in the states of Parana, Santa Catarina and Rio Grande do Sul, carrying grains, oil and alcohol.
Last year it transported 13.6 million tonnes of freight.
The winning bidder will have to pay 20 percent of the total amount in cash immediately, with the balance due in 112 instalments after a two-year grace period.
The southern stretch is the fifth of six federal railway sections to be privatized. The last section, the Northeast branch, is expected to go on sale next year.
((-- Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro Newsroom 55-21-5074151))
